title: Tech Note: A Module for Managing Recursive Relationships
author: Forrest Swilling
featured_technology: Arrays (SELECTION TO ARRAY, Find in array)

historical_commentary.text: This note extends a classic two-file recursive relationship pattern (from a 1990 Tech Note) with a reusable module of procedures (FindBranch, FindNonBranch, FindNextLevel, FindOrphans, FindTop) built on 4D's PROJECT SELECTION, JOIN, and Set commands to navigate arbitrarily deep hierarchical/tree data (file structures, genealogies, bills of materials, org charts); the specific classic-4D-language commands and idioms are largely superseded by modern 4D language features (and, for genuinely hierarchical data, arguably by JSON/ORDA-based structures), but the conceptual recursive relationship pattern itself remains a standard, still-relevant data-modeling technique in relational databases generally.
related_updates: The specific commands used (PROJECT SELECTION, CREATE SET/UNION/DIFFERENCE, SELECTION TO ARRAY) are classic 4D language-era idioms; modern 4D offers newer collection/entity-selection based approaches (ORDA) that can express similar hierarchical queries differently

The core recursive/self-referencing relationship pattern for hierarchical data (parent-child trees) remains a standard, still-used relational data modeling technique across databases generally, independent of 4D version
